bottleneck.evidence: sha-matched result.json runs/glm52/moe_total_decode/20260724T221808Z-9066dd (candidate.sha256 76dc7553...93db6f07 == committed testbench/tasks/glm52_amd/moe_total_decode/candidate.py, git_dirty=False) at unified S/KV=32768, --repeat 10 --iterations 30 --warmup 3: per-shape speedup M16 1.0849 / M32 1.0338 (conservative 1.0725/1.0229), worst_calc_diff 0.0, 2/2 shape_verdict=win, shapes_regressed 0, min_speedup_conservative 1.0229. Authority taskset sweep independently 6/6 win geo ~1.059 (M in {1,4,8,16,32,64}). At tiny decode M the default BLOCK_SIZE_M=128 pads most rows per tile -> wasted launch/compute.

approaches.summary: Shrink BLOCK_SIZE_M to max(16, min(128, next_pow2(M))) (min-only; never grow) on both gemm1/down fp8 configs, gated to dense topk==E and M<=32, then call the reference's OWN _fused_moe_kernel_sequence. Landed as the committed AMD candidate -- fixing the prior committed wrong-phase fallback reference('moe_total','prefill') to reference('moe_total','decode') -- and re-gated from committed bytes at S/KV=32768.
approaches.why: At tiny decode M the default BLOCK_SIZE_M=128 pads most rows per tile; shrinking to the next power of two matching per-expert rows cuts wasted launch/compute while leaving BLOCK_SIZE_K/N and the fp8 math untouched (calc_diff 0.0). Wins M16 1.0849 / M32 1.0338.

lesson: moe_total_decode fp8 win on gfx942 is a bit-exact BLOCK_SIZE_M shrink (min-only, dense topk==E & M<=32) driving the reference's own _fused_moe_kernel_sequence: sha-matched re-gate from committed bytes (sha 76dc7553) at unified S/KV=32768 gives 2/2 win geo 1.059 (M16 1.085 / M32 1.034, worst_calc_diff 0.0), and the authority taskset sweep confirms 6/6 (M in {1,4,8,16,32,64}). Landing MUST set the reference fallback phase to 'decode' -- a prior commit shipped reference('moe_total','prefill'), a latent wrong-phase bug the landing fixed. Never touch BLOCK_SIZE_K.
